nodes.label: Chrono_fsisph_vsg visualization plugin
nodes.rationale: Split into its own target so the VSG dependency stays optional; under HIP the plugin's .cpp is compiled with LANGUAGE HIP because it includes FSI data-manager headers that reference rocThrust/rocPRIM device types which do not compile as plain C++.

nodes.label: CUDA/HIP GPU backend selection for SPH
nodes.rationale: Chrono::FSI::SPH self-disables unless CHRONO_CUDA_FOUND or CHRONO_HIP_FOUND (and Eigen >= 3.3.6). The same .cu/.cpp source list (FSISPH_GPU_SOURCE_FILES) is retargeted via set_source_files_properties(LANGUAGE HIP) rather than duplicated, so one source tree serves both vendors.

nodes.label: HIP compile-flag isolation from public consumers
nodes.rationale: hip::host, the HIP Thrust device system, and HIP_ARCHITECTURES are kept PRIVATE (HIP_ARCHITECTURES is set OFF and --offload-arch passed only to real HIP translation units). Public consumers are ordinary C++ TUs that only need ROCm headers for declarations; inheriting the HIP target's definitions would force Thrust onto the rocPRIM backend and leak --offload-arch into host compiles such as stb_image.cpp.

nodes.label: Splashsurf surface reconstruction utility
nodes.rationale: Located at configure time as an external executable, not a linked library; its absence only turns off CHRONO_HAS_SPLASHSURF in the generated ChFsiConfigSPH.h rather than disabling the module.
